sources.evidence: Falkland Beerworks' official site states that the Falkland Islands has its own brewery and that Falkland Beerworks produces hand-crafted ales using traditional methods.
The official Beers page lists current Falkland Beerworks products including Longdon Pride, Rock Hopper, Peat Cutter and Black Tarn.
The Falkland Beerworks merchandise page identifies the brewery tap room at 60 John Street, Stanley, supporting the current physical-site location.

The official Falkland Islands visitor site currently lists Falkland Beerworks at 60 John Street, Stanley and describes it as a family-run craft brewery offering fresh locally brewed traditional craft beers.
